podcast.title: Birth through Milt Gabler's Expansion
podcast.body: Commodore Records was founded by Milt Gabler as an expansion from his successful reissue label, initially remaining a minor label until the release of "Strange Fruit." "After he had some success with that, he branched out into making new records on a new label, Commodore."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 4: "Choo Choo Ch'Boogie" by Louis Jordan

podcast.title: Co-ownership by Billy Crystal's Father
podcast.body: Commodore Records was co-owned by the father of actor Billy Crystal. Billie Holiday recorded for this label, leading to her connection with the Crystal family. "Holiday recorded for Commodore Records, which was co-owned by Crystal's father."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: 60 Mind Blowing Facts in 60 Minutes: The 5th Edition
